title: I Printed the Science-Center Demo-Table Roster After They Took My Cart

parts.text: I signed demo table 2 at 1:03 p.m. and educator Cole had already rolled my cart to table 1 for a VIP tour. The roster said: CART FOLLOWS THE TABLE. VIPS WATCH, NOT TAKE. I was twenty-four, floor volunteer, holding a empty bay. Cole did not roll it back. "Tours are the floor." I photographed the roster, the empty bay, and the cart at 1. Then I logged a take. At 1:11 the floor supervisor asked why Cole's VIP was on table 2's cart. I let them finish the sentence they would regret in writing. Petty is a word people use when their name is on the ticket.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: The floor supervisor can see table 2's cart at table 1 on a VIP tour.

social.video_title: He rolled my demo cart to a VIP table — Part 1/2
social.description: Science center, a roster, and an empty bay. I logged the take. Would you have photographed the cart?

parts.text: Cole called it wow until the supervisor asked for the log. I printed the take, the photo, and the roster. The cart rolled back. Cole wowed with table 1's own kit and told educators wow was always about optics. Optics is a word tours use when a cart exists. Demo policy now has a second line: VIPS WATCH. I keep table 2. Cole tours. The floor finally looks like science, not a borrow. Nobody thanked me, which is how you know a policy finally works. A paper policy is only paper until someone treats it like a clock.

social.description: Take log, returned cart, and a second line. Was wow ever my bay?
